face.name: 风暴聚合器
face.text: 随机将你的所有随从变形成为传说随从。
face.flavorText: 伊莱克特拉终于可以在家办公了。

face.name: The Storm Bringer
face.text: Transform your minions into random Legendary minions.
face.flavorText: Finally, Electra can work from home.

face.name: 衰变
face.text: 随机将所有 敌方随从变形成为法力值消耗减少（1）点的随从。
face.flavorText: 鱼人宣称，该技能充分表明所有物种的祖先都是鱼人！

face.name: Devolve
face.text: Transform all enemy minions into random ones that cost (1) less.
face.flavorText: Ragnaros looked down. He looked like some kind of War Golem. "WHAT HAVE YOU DONE TO ME," he yelled. But all that came out was a deep grinding sound. He began to cry.

face.name: 突变
face.text: 将一个友方随从随机变形成为一个法力值消耗增加（1）点的随从。
face.flavorText: 想得到预期的突变结果？除非鱼人都会飞！

face.name: Mutate
face.text: Transform a friendly minion into a random one that costs (1) more.
face.flavorText: You'll get the transformation you want when murlocs fly.

face.name: 不稳定的异变
face.text: 回响 将一个友方随从随机变形成为一个法力值消耗增加（1）点的随从。
face.flavorText: 它们长得真快。

face.name: Unstable Evolution
face.text: Echo Transform a friendly minion into one that costs (1) more.
face.flavorText: They grow up so fast.

face.name: 异变
face.text: 随机将你的 所有随从变形成为法力值消耗增加（1）点的随从。
face.flavorText: 诡异的眼球，黏滑的触须，阴阳怪气的语调……这种变化不要也罢。

face.name: Evolve
face.text: Transform your minions into random minions that cost (1) more.
face.flavorText: So you say you want an evolution. Well, you know. We all want to change the board.

face.name: 始源之潮
face.text: 将敌方随从变形成为法力值消耗减少（1）点的随从，将友方随从变形成为法力值消耗增加（1）点的随从。
face.flavorText: 有味道的插画，有味道的名字。

face.name: Primordial Wave
face.text: Transform enemy minions into ones that cost (1) less and friendly minions into ones that cost (1) more.
face.flavorText: A primordial hello to you too!

face.name: 惊爆异变
face.text: 将一个随从随机变形成为一个法力值消耗增加（3）点的 随从。
face.flavorText: 一起为地精的实验助一臂之力！

face.name: Explosive Evolution
face.text: Transform a minion into a random one that costs (3) more.
face.flavorText: Let's give a big hand for goblin experimentation!

face.name: 治疗波
face.text: 恢复 8点生命值。揭示双方牌库里的一张随从牌。如果你的牌法力值 消耗较大，改为恢复 16点生命值。
face.flavorText: 恢复系萨满最钟爱的技能之一。治疗效果出众，广受盟友好评。

face.name: Healing Wave
face.text: Restore 8 Health. Reveal a minion in each deck. If yours costs more, restore 16 instead.
face.flavorText: Favored by shaman who study the art of restoration and healing, this spell would feel smug, if it had feelings.

face.name: 治疗波
face.text: 恢复 8点生命值。揭示双方牌库里的一张随从牌。如果你的牌法力值 消耗较大，改为恢复 16点生命值。
face.flavorText: 恢复系萨满最钟爱的技能之一。治疗效果出众，广受盟友好评。

face.name: Healing Wave
face.text: Restore 8 Health. Reveal a minion in each deck. If yours costs more, restore 16 instead.
face.flavorText: Favored by shaman who study the art of restoration and healing, this spell would feel smug, if it had feelings.

face.name: 先知者沃
face.text: 扰魔。在你施放一个法术后，&发现一张来自过去的自然法术牌。
face.flavorText: 她冥想了两个星期，心无旁骛地探知着宇宙的每一个角落，事无巨细，无所不包。当她从冥想中醒来，口中只吐出了一个声音：“喔。”

face.name: Farseer Wo
face.text: Elusive After you cast a spell,& Discover a Nature spell from the past.
face.flavorText: For two weeks, she meditated in silence, undisturbed as she peered into the endless, unfolding facets of the universe. No pathway lay unexplored, no stone left unturned. When she finally snapped from her fugue, she uttered a single word: "Woah."

policies.legendary: Original active friendly board; complete collectible Legendary view without source cost tier. Original captured board references, full pool validation and ordinary per-recipient sampling/transform.
policies.costs: Existing printed source cost, Evolve10 cap/above10 tier and Devolve lower-available-tier policy unchanged; real Echo uses ordinary temporary hand material/payment/expiry.
policies.groups: Primordial Wave first enemy Devolve group then friendly Evolve group via existing staged board producer.
policies.joust: Original physical minion reveal from both decks, original stored costs, strict own greater comparison and existing empty-deck policy. Original target then ordinary8/16 SPELL healing.

uncertainties: Source/current face, zero-tier fallback and two-sided transformation interleavings keep existing explicit local policies, not CN calibration.
Original full71 source remains unbound; no executable subset pool.
Current frozen sources only: patch/hotfix and CN edge calibration deferred.
